name: CacheRegionNew
description: This function exists solely for the purpose of compatibility with other CFML Engines.
syntax: CacheRegionNew( string cacheName, [any properties], [any throwOnError], [string password] )

params.name: cacheName
params.description: the name of the cache connection to create (also known as Region in other CFML engines).

params.name: properties
params.description: a structure specifying the cache properties

params.name: throwOnError
params.description:
specifies whether the function should throw an exception if a cache connection with that name already exists.

Default is true.

params.name: password
params.description:
the password for the web administrator is required to interact with Cache Connections.
You can optionally set it for your Application in Application.cfc using the variable [this.webAdminPassword].
